evidence: New job "Senior Backend Developer" successfully posted with all required fields (title, industry, employment type, location, valid salary range, description, skills) and appears in both employer dashboard and job seeker listing. Job count increased from 8 to 9.
Job seekers can browse complete job list. Showing 9 jobs with accurate count displayed. Each job card is clickable and opens the full details page.

Application form accepts name, valid email, optional phone, and message. Success notification displayed: "Application submitted! Your application for Senior Backend Developer at TechCorp Solutions has been sent."

Job card displays: title (Senior Backend Developer), company (TechCorp Solutions), industry (Technology), employment type (Full-time), location (New York, NY), salary ($120k - $160k), date (Yesterday), skills (Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL)
Job details page displays matching info: title, company, industry, employment type, location, salary, date, full description, required skills. All fields present and accurate.
Application displays: applicant name (Alice Johnson), email (alice.johnson@example.com), phone (555-1234), message (full text), submission date (Yesterday) as distinct record under the matching job.
New job posted shows "Yesterday" as submission date (relative to current date 2026-08-24). Application shows "Yesterday" as submission date. Both use relative date format.

Submitted application appears exactly once under the matching job in employer dashboard with submitted information (Alice Johnson, alice.johnson@example.com, 555-1234, full message, date). Total applications count increased from 3 to 4.
Employer dashboard displays: "6 Active Jobs" (for current employer) and "4 Total Applications". Counts are accurate: 6 jobs visible in the listings, 4 applications total across them (1+2+1+0+0+0).
Employer can click applications button for each job to view list. Successfully opened applications for "Senior Backend Developer" and viewed the full application details.

Employer can delete job after confirming action in dialog. Job and its 1 application removed from employer dashboard (Active Jobs 6→5, Total Applications 4→3) and from job seeker listing (count 9→8). Dialog text: "This will permanently delete 'Senior Backend Developer' and all its applications."

Filter by Industry (Technology) - job count changed from 8 to 2, showing only Technology jobs. Clearing filter restored all 8 jobs immediately. Filters work individually and in combination. No-results state properly shown when needed.

Keyword search "Frontend" matched job title and returned 1 result (Senior Frontend Developer). Search is case-insensitive and matches without requiring exact case. Result count updated immediately from 8 to 1. Search works for job titles.

Filtering by Industry and searching by keyword both immediately refresh matching jobs and result count. No page reload needed. Clearing criteria restores full list immediately. UI updates in real-time.

Email validation working at HTML5 level. Submitting form with invalid email "notanemail" showed validation message: "Please include an '@' in the email address." Required field validation prevents submission when fields are empty. Invalid field is identified to the user via browser's native validation UI.

Job posting form has HTML5 validation for all required fields. Attempted to submit empty form - validation prevented submission with messages for missing fields (title, salary fields, description). Salary validation works (accepts min=120000, max=160000). At least one required skill must be added (form requires skill for posting). Invalid data cannot be submitted.

actual: Submitted application with bob.smith@example.com to Senior Frontend Developer job. Then submitted second application with same email (different name "Bob Smith 2", different message). System accepted both applications (temporarily showed 4 applications, then both appeared as separate entries in dashboard list).

issue: Data not persisted after page reload
actual: Added applications to Senior Frontend Developer job (count increased from 2 to 4). After page reload, applications reverted back to original 2 (Alex Johnson, Maria Garcia). Bob Smith's applications disappeared. Total application count dropped from 5 back to 3.

issue: Edit functionality not implemented or not accessible
actual: On employer dashboard, each job has 2 buttons: one for viewing applications (numbered), one that triggers delete confirmation. No visible edit button found. Attempting to click on job title or other areas doesn't open edit form. Edit functionality appears to be missing from the UI.
